posts.name: Chinmoy Das
posts.cooked: I would like to request the reopening of both the OPPE VM and the Course VM. I have been using an office Ubuntu laptop due to its superior performance, but I will need to return it tomorrow. As I will be switching to my personal Windows laptop for the reOPPE next Saturday, I kindly request that you accommodate this so I can update my SSH key accordingly.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: OPPE Vm will be re-opened only on the day of exam. You can submit your public key to both VMs. Course vm will check.

posts.name: Chinmoy Das
posts.cooked: Oh okay i just need to upload the public key of my windows laptop in the website and it should work right
